items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I got with the show playing -- leading the band with a little show starring Pigmeat Markham.

ctx.x: And how long did you stay in Durham, just the summer?
Well, no. I stayed in Durham for a good little while, then we got -- I got with the show playing -- leading the band with a little show starring Pigmeat Markham.
